limits: Three short repeats per mode; descriptive medians/ranges, no statistical significance or sustained capacity claim.
Each1s warmup precedes a3s measured phase; elapsed includes drain.
FULL=2 on all2000 provider connections; fullfsync/checkpoint_fullfsync=0; no power-cut qualification.
Terminal process I/O includes server close, provider drops, background and observer work after setup/warmups/all phases; not exact checkpoint-only or timed-write attribution.
Pager counts log submissions in WAL and database writes in DELETE; checkpoint database rewrites and syncs are outside the pager counter.
Boundary database/WAL/SHM gauges omit transient rollback journals and do not measure physical writes or complete disk footprint.
Process write bytes are OS accounting; selected host driver IOPS include parent logs and other host traffic; no SSD/NAND attribution.
Raw JSON observer banks allocate and remain retained across phases; RSS is not workload-only, and allocation churn is not enabled in this binary.
FULL journaling and current chunk/metadata format unchanged between arms; production journal defaults unchanged.
Actual checkpoint count/time and steady-state long-run behavior remain unmeasured.
Client traffic uses test wire helpers; this is not production CLI/provider or OS mount throughput.
client_path: direct test wire helpers; production remote client and local OS mount path not exercised
